spec.title: Immediate task completion persistence in festina-implement
spec.context:
When implementing large plans, tasks get executed successfully but are not marked complete in plan.xml because context exhaustion occurs before the mark_task_complete substep runs. The current skill has mark_task_complete at the end of the task execution loop (after confirm_done_criteria), meaning large plans exhaust context before all marking steps complete.
Evidence: In plan 029, tasks 2-8 have identical timestamps (2026-02-28T15:45:00Z) suggesting bulk marking rather than incremental persistence. Similarly in plan 010, tasks 3-6 share timestamp 2026-02-23T15:00:22.701Z.
This causes confusion about progress and potential re-implementation of already-completed tasks when sessions are resumed.

in-scope.item: Reorder mark_task_complete to run immediately after verification passes
Handle both auto verification tasks and manual verification tasks
Remove the now-redundant separate mark_task_complete substep

out-of-scope.item: Retroactive fixes to existing plans with identical timestamps

requirements.requirement: The system shall mark auto-verification tasks as complete immediately after verification succeeds (exit code 0), before confirm_done_criteria runs
The system shall mark manual-verification tasks as complete immediately after outputting the deferral message, before confirm_done_criteria runs
The system shall persist completion to plan.xml after each task completion (not in bulk at end)
Each task shall have its own unique completion timestamp reflecting when that specific task completed

files.file: Reorder task completion logic within execute_tasks step

patterns.pattern: Tasks use XML substep elements with name attributes: show_task_context, execute_action, run_verification, confirm_done_criteria Reference: `.claude/skills/festina-implement/SKILL.md:269-323`
Task completion uses attributes: completed="true" completed_at="{ISO timestamp}" Reference: `.claude/skills/festina-implement/SKILL.md:320`

codebase.finding: festina-implement SKILL.md defines 5 substeps in execute_tasks: show_task_context, execute_action, run_verification, confirm_done_criteria, mark_task_complete
Evidence of bulk marking in plan 010: tasks 3-6 share timestamp 2026-02-23T15:00:22.701Z
Evidence of bulk marking in plan 029: tasks 2-8 share timestamp 2026-02-28T15:45:00Z

pitfall.mitigation: Only mark complete after successful verification (exit code 0) - current behavior preserved

pitfall.issue: Manual verification tasks have no automated verification
pitfall.mitigation: Mark complete immediately after deferral message since there's no verification to wait for

risk.mitigation: Only move marking logic, no functional changes to verification
